summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself as a shared React repo config (ESLint/Prettier), but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release CDN, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using string-array rotator obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator, large mixed constant table, hex-named `_0x...` identifiers). The loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with the same fingerprint (obfuscator-style hex identifiers, per-function wrapper objects such as `YCZJE: function(f,a,b,c){return f(a,b,c)}`). The alternate-runtime fetch is not from the tool's own official install channel used for its documented purpose — the Bun runtime is fetched to execute an opaque bundled payload unrelated to a shared lint config. The combination of obfuscated install-time loader, download of a second language runtime, and execution of an unreviewable bundled payload during `npm install` is the canonical alternate-runtime dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
